prompt:
Theme direction: Oriental Zen minimalist cover poster.
Style branch: New Chinese style with feminine aesthetics.
Subject content: An ancient-style woman standing between tiered platforms, hand resting on a low railing.
Emotional motif: Elegant, composed, fresh premium feel.
Scene and imagery: Dark green arched background structure, beige platforms, woman, sparse plant silhouettes.
Composition and space: 9:16 vertical composition, arch structure in upper middle, tiered platforms creating depth in lower half, figure positioned slightly off-center in lower middle, clean title area left at top.
Color control: Beige as overall base, dark green for arch background and plant silhouettes, light gold only for minimal local highlights; suggest light beige or pale bean-green white for clothing; avoid overall green tint.
Lighting and texture: Bright soft light, clean structure, clear outlines, modern new-Chinese flat poster feel.
Aspect ratio: 9:16.
Additional requirements: Arch structure should be simple and sharp, hierarchical relationships clear, overall premium and fresh, suitable for high-virality covers, appropriate text placed in whitespace areas.
